data.text: On my way to Manila. The car isn’t moving because of traffic, so I guess the driver wants small talk. He asked what concert I’m attending. I blacked out for 30 seconds. 🤣 I never know what to say when strangers ask me these things. 🤣 Then he asked if the performer is a foreigner. If they’re Korean. 🤣 I wanted to tell him I’m going to see the Queen of Thailand. 🤣

⚠️Traffic Advisory⚠️ Two separate groups congregating.  

Expect delays on Alameda between Aliso and Temple due to people in the street.  

Expect delays on Spring St between Temple and 1st due to a demonstration in front of City Hall.  

Additional demonstration entering Alameda from Commercial.
